item.title: CVE-2026-126297 · NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in ConllCorpusReader SRL instance builder via nested span rescan
item.description: ## Summary `ConllCorpusReader.srl_instances()` builds semantic-role-labeling instances from a CoNLL corpus block. For a sentence block with P predicates and P span columns, the instance builder rescans every span column (and every span within it) once per predicate while searching for each predicate's head, giving O(P^2 * R) work. A single well-formed block that places the head span in the last column forces the full scan on every predicate, so | Producto: nltk | Corrección: 3.10.4

item.title: CVE-2026-126298 · NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in Tree.chomsky_normal_form right-factor binarization via list.pop(0)
item.description: ## Summary `Tree.chomsky_normal_form()` binarizes a parse tree and defaults to right factoring. For a node with N children the right-factor branch repeatedly removes the first element of a working list with `list.pop(0)`, which shifts all remaining elements each time, so binarizing one wide node costs O(N^2). An application that converts an attacker-supplied treebank tree to Chomsky Normal Form can be forced into tens of seconds of single-thread | Producto: nltk | Corrección: 3.10.4

item.title: CVE-2026-126299 · NLTK: Quadratic-time CPU denial of service in CCG lexicon parser (fromstring) on wide bracket bodies and operator chains
item.description: ## Summary The public CCG lexicon parser `nltk.ccg.lexicon.fromstring` parses caller-influenced lexicon text with two pure-Python loops whose cost is quadratic in the input width. A service that parses an untrusted CCG lexicon string can be driven into tens of seconds of single-threaded CPU by a few-megabyte input, starving the request worker. No authentication or user interaction is required. ## Root Cause `matchBrackets` consumes a bracket b | Producto: nltk | Corrección: 3.10.4

item.title: CVE-2026-128077 · Nuxt: Incomplete fix for GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33: a leading `//` in the request path bypasses `server/middleware` path checks and server route rules on page routes
